name: 23662 · Poquoson, VA
findings: ZIP 23662 (Poquoson) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23662 (Poquoson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23662 (Poquoson) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
